subject: Your refund clocks and the phone desk
body:
Your refund clock is 72 hours on a cruise-only booking and 21 days once transportation is on it. The person answering the phone has to know which one applies before the guest hangs up. We already did the study on that. The first thing in it doesn't cost anything.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/major-marine-tours/

Worth a reply either way.
